subject: Intermittent proxy failures during Brightlane SDK demo — triage + short-term workaround
messages:
From: Evan <evan@brightlane.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Issues with SDK demo behind corp proxy

Hey Stephanie —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We hit intermittent failures when streaming the demo content to our internal audience: ~3x during a 20 minute session. Symptoms: the client stops receiving tokens and the demo window shows a ‘generation error’ after ~10–20s. Our infra team pulled a few logs and attached a trimmed log file (brightlane_demo_log.txt).

Quick details: Brightlane uses an outbound enterprise proxy that terminates idle connections after 15s. Our demo machines are standard corp laptops. We haven’t changed any network settings during the test.

We’re in the final procurement stage and this is a blocker — can your team help triage urgently? If there’s a short-term config we can flip in the SDK to make the demos reliable, that would be ideal.

— Evan
Evan Carter
Head of Partner Ops, Brightlane
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Evan <evan@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Issues with SDK demo behind corp proxy

Hi Evan — thanks for the log and the context. Sorry you hit that during the demo. Looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Dev/Karthik (runtime/product) so we can triage.

Immediate ask from our side: could you confirm whether the failures always happen when a long-lived generation is idle >15s (i.e., long streaming responses), or if they happen on short single-shot requests as well? The log you gave shows several TCP resets but it’s trimmed — if you can run the attached collection script (redwood-requested-collection.sh) it will collect the full request/response headers and TLS handshake timing.

Proposed short-term workaround (we’ll validate): set the SDK env var REDWOOD_SDK_TCP_KEEPALIVE=1 and set REDWOOD_SDK_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL=10 to keep connections alive across the proxy timeout. If that’s easy for your demo hosts to toggle we can continue the deal while we investigate a more robust fix.

I’ll coordinate a quick triage call if needed after Dev reviews the logs.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Issues with SDK demo behind corp proxy

Folks —

Context for prioritization: Brightlane is at a late-stage procurement milestone (purchase order pending). They did an internal exec demo this morning and the instability materially impacted their confidence. They’re asking for a workaround we can recommend to their desktop admins quickly.

Two asks from Sales:
- Confirm whether the env var keepalive suggestion is safe for short-term use in prod demos.
- If a small SDK flag (e.g., --bypass-proxy-detection or REDWOOD_SDK_BYPASS_PROXY) is feasible, can we surface that as an opt-in while the runtime fix lands?

I’ve added the HubSpot link to the thread for visibility. If Dev needs me to escalate procurement for a short-term PO hold, say the word.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Issues with SDK demo behind corp proxy — initial triage

Thanks for the signal and logs. Quick notes from runtime triage:

- Initial hypothesis: connection pooling + proxy idle timeout is causing the HTTP/2 stream reuse to fail; client sees ECONNRESET during a long-poll streaming session. The trimmed proxy_trace_excerpt.log (attached) includes a sequence of FIN/RESET around the 12–17s mark.
- Repro steps (local): run the SDK streaming client against a proxy with an enforced idle timeout (we reproduce with a 15s timeout using mitmproxy).

Short-term actionables I can take this morning:
1) Add a diagnostic flag to the SDK to emit per-connection keepalive pings (non-breaking, opt-in). Will ship a debug build and instructions.
2) Validate the recommended env vars (REDWOOD_SDK_TCP_KEEPALIVE / KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL) on mac/linux demo hosts — should be safe, but need to confirm across our HTTP/2 codepaths.

Longer-term: we should consider exposing an explicit proxy-mode config and a connection re-establishment policy in the SDK so clients behind enterprise proxies can opt into conservative pooling.

Assigning to myself to produce a debug binary and a short README for Brightlane. ETA for debug build: EOD Fri. ETA for RFC/feature ticket: next week.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2027 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Feature ask: explicit proxy mode & conservative pooling policy

Thanks team — I agree with Dev’s hypothesis. Product ask / roadmap note: we need a low-friction SDK knob for customers behind enterprise proxies and a documented best-practice for demo environments. Proposed scope:

- SDK config flag (REDWOOD_SDK_PROXY_MODE = [auto|conservative|bypass]) with conservative mode disabling aggressive connection reuse and enabling keepalive pings.
- Short-term: ship conservative mode as feature flag (no breaking changes).
- Backlog ticket: SUP-3456 (created, link above).

If Sales confirms this rank-high, we can prioritize a small sprint in Q1. For now, Dev’s debug build + the keepalive env vars as a stop-gap is the path forward. Please confirm the EOD debug build delivery and whether we should push a pre-release to the Brightlane testers.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Serving Runtime
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2027 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent proxy failures during Brightlane SDK demo — triage + short-term workaround

Recap and next steps:

1) Dev will produce a debug SDK build (opt-in) and a README with the recommended env var toggles — ETA: EOD Fri, 01/08 (Dev confirmed).
2) Sales (Marissa) will ask Brightlane to set REDWOOD_SDK_TCP_KEEPALIVE=1 and REDWOOD_SDK_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL=10 on their demo hosts as an immediate mitigation.
3) Product (Karthik) created SUP-3456 to track the explicit proxy-mode feature; target Q1 sprint for conservative pooling.
4) Logistics: I’ll schedule a 30 minute follow-up triage call with Brightlane for Wed 01/13; Marissa, please advise if that needs to be earlier.

Attachments in the thread: brightlane_demo_log.txt, proxy_trace_excerpt.log, redwood-requested-collection.sh (scripts/logs).

If anyone needs me to escalate this to EC for a PO hold or a demo credit, call it out here. Otherwise I’ll coordinate the follow-up and mark the lead as at-risk until we confirm the demo stability.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
